title: Dispatch - Trade Companion
features: Google and Apple sign-in only (no email, password or phone)
Trade screen usable before any wallet is connected
Markets BTC, ETH, SOL with live reference prices
Long or Short, Now or When price hits (trigger order)
Bet size, entry price and leverage
Optional take profit / stop loss pair with price-and-percent editor and visual price scale
Wallet connect only on Post tap: major wallet apps + WalletConnect (bottom sheets)
Two signatures: prove ownership, then grant 30-day trade-only permission (no per-trade signing)
Permission expiry: warning at 5 days left, blocking re-sign when expired or when exits could cross expiry
Orders list: waiting trigger orders + completed results
Push notifications on order and position status
Weekly rewards: half of builder fees shared to users in USDC by volume, $10 minimum
App never holds funds: no deposit, withdraw or transfer

bottomTabBar.note: Flat white bar, hairline top border, 3 tabs in this exact order. Active tab = ink label + accent-filled pill behind icon; inactive = tertiary ink. Settings is NOT a tab, it is a gear icon top-right of the Trade header.

sharedComponents.statusBar: Top header row: left = small postmark-style circular stamp logo mark + screen title, right = gear icon (Trade screen only) or nothing. When a wallet is connected, a small chip shows the shortened address (0x7a3f...91c2) with a green dot.
sharedComponents.controls: Primary button: full-width pill 56px, accent #9FE870 fill with ink #141F0C label (dark label on bright lime), pressed = #8FD660, disabled = #E3E9DE fill + tertiary label. Secondary: white pill with 1.5px ink border. Input: 12px radius, border #7E8A74, focus = 2px accent ring, error = danger. Card: white, 20px radius, soft shadow. Postal ticket card: the order ticket card has a perforated stamp edge on top (small scalloped semicircle notches) like a postage stamp. Chip: pill, 13px label. Segmented control: pill track #F2F6EE, selected segment white with soft shadow. Long uses success green, Short uses danger red (trading convention), both with an icon arrow.

screens.name: login
screens.purpose: Sign in with Google or Apple, nothing else
screens.content: Top: postmark stamp logo mark. Hero real photo: a single cream envelope with a lime wax-seal sticker resting on a white desk, soft daylight. Headline 'Trade like sending a letter.' subline 'Open and close BTC, ETH and SOL positions in seconds.' Buttons: 'Continue with Apple' (black pill, white label), 'Continue with Google' (white pill, ink border, Google G). Footnote small: 'No email, no password. Dispatch never holds your funds.' Terms + Privacy links.

type.minSize: 12px (13px chips and tags, 14px safety or legal text)
type.scaleRule: Use only the 5 declared sizes (display, title, body, label, caption).

designSystem.icons: Lucide-style rounded outline, 24px, 1.75 stroke, one set
designSystem.a11y: lime accent carries ink labels only; white labels only on accentFill #57803E; 44pt tap targets
designSystem.brand: postal / send a letter: postmark circle stamp mark, perforated stamp edges on ticket cards, envelope and paper plane motifs, 'Post trade' CTA, 'Delivered' stamps. Clean, white, minimal, big primary numbers, small quiet labels.
